description: Edit an OPEN sales order the same way the Sales Orders page's Save does: add lines (addLines — itemSku/itemUpc/itemId + quantity, optional unitPrice), change lines (updateLines — lineId from get_sales_order plus a new quantity and/or unitPrice), remove lines (removeLineIds), and change the customer (customerId / customerEmail / customerName), the customer PO reference, the requested ship date, or the notes. Every field is preserve-on-omit; pass an empty string to clear a note, PO reference or requested ship date. Orders awaiting approval, shipping/shipped, completed or canceled cannot be edited (the UI locks them too). Reservations, pick lists, pricing, tax and totals are re-synced by the canonical update. A draft (status "created") is not refused for short stock — the shortfall is a warning, and issuing the draft is refused until the stock is there. The preview returns the per-field old→new diff and the resulting line set, and its receipt is bound to the order's current version — an edit landing in between rejects the commit. A client-pinned token only sees its own client's orders and items. Max 500 resulting lines.

addLines.description: Lines to add (each itemSku/itemUpc/itemId + quantity, optional unitPrice/uomId).

itemId.description: Item id (GUID) — the alternative to itemSku. Provide exactly one of the three.

itemSku.description: Item SKU to sell. Provide exactly one of itemSku, itemUpc or itemId. Resolved against the tenant's catalog (a client-pinned token only resolves its own client's items).

itemUpc.description: Item UPC/barcode — the alternative to itemSku. Provide exactly one of the three.

quantity.description: REQUIRED. Quantity to sell, in the item's default unit of measure unless uomId is given (must be greater than zero).

unitPrice.description: Optional manual unit price in the order's currency. Omit to price the line from the customer's price book / the item's list price at commit time, exactly as the UI does.

uomId.description: Optional unit-of-measure id (GUID) for this line. Omit to sell in the item's default UOM.

clientId.description: Optional 3PL client id (GUID) to scope the lookup to; refused when it differs from a pinned token's client.

customerEmail.description: Change the customer by email (exact match to a customer record).

customerId.description: Change the customer by id (GUID). Provide at most one of customerId, customerEmail, customerName.

customerName.description: Change the customer by exact name; an unmatched name is recorded as free text.

customerPurchaseOrder.description: New customer purchase-order reference; empty string clears it.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

internalNote.description: New internal note; empty string clears it.

note.description: New customer-facing note; empty string clears it.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive the old→new diff plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing changes until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

removeLineIds.description: Existing line ids (GUIDs, from get_sales_order) to remove.

requestedShipDate.description: New date the customer asked the order to ship, YYYY-MM-DD on the tenant's calendar; empty string clears it.

salesOrderId.description: The sales order id (GUID) to edit.

updateLines.description: Existing lines to change, addressed by lineId (from get_sales_order).

lineId.description: REQUIRED. The existing line id (GUID) from get_sales_order lines[].lineId.

quantity.description: New quantity (greater than zero). Omit to keep the current quantity.

unitPrice.description: New manual unit price. Omit to keep the current price (and its manual/catalog pricing mode).

name: update_sales_order
title: Update Sales Order
